name: Kariyane Yuma
source:
"Aren't you afraid of death?"

The president of "Yukito Funeral Home" where Minazuki works. He treats everyone with kindness and courtesy, and cares about each and every employee.

He's known as a handsome and accomplished president, often featured in news and interviews.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1877744486131912727]
